methodology.corpora: Two corpora over the same 599 test reports: RAG actions (3 per report), and human G_r sentences (3-LLM-intersection agreed remediation sentences, never truncated).
methodology.document_definition: One document = one report's items joined by a space (build_block_text). Corpus metrics pool across documents; per-report metrics recompute inside a single document.

caveats.per_report_cr: Per-report gzip CR is length-confounded: gzip's fixed header and 32 KiB window are not amortised by a ~50-token block, so shorter blocks score lower CR independently of redundancy. Read with words_per_block.
caveats.self_bleu_intra_set_n: A report with a single item has no within-report pair, so its intra-set Self-BLEU is undefined and it is dropped. Effective n is below the report count for G_r.
caveats.vp_count_asymmetry: RAG verb phrases are counted over the generated actions; G_r verb phrases are counted over all of that report's agreed sentences.

statistics.test: two-sided Mann-Whitney U, RAG vs G_r, on per-report values
statistics.effect_size: rank-biserial r = 1 - 2U/(n1*n2); r>0 means RAG ranks above G_r
statistics.secondary: Wilcoxon signed-rank on the report-aligned differences (same 599 reports on both sides), Holm-corrected over the same family
